_spec.purpose: Joke-structure variety. Without this the show becomes one gag shape repeated until it dies. An angle TYPE may not be used more than twice in any 7 episodes. Phase 3.5 reads it, Phase 7 appends.

entries.angle: Microsoft raised the price of Office, called it a 'packaging and pricing update', and the official FAQ explaining it contains no prices.

Ford recalled 43,438 of these SUVs in October for a sound they would not make, updated the software and mailed the letters; in June the same recall came back covering 66,383, and the cars they already fixed have to be fixed again.

The report wrote the same eviction case out again and again, and counted each copy as another time he was sued. It is not wrong about anything: every copy is accurate, and being accurate that many times is what makes the total false.
